item.text: The literal value fails because EXCLURAD defines \(Q^2=-q^2>0\). I’m treating “Q2 = -0.5” as the common signed \(q^2=-0.5\ \mathrm{GeV}^2\) convention and correcting the EXCLURAD input to \(Q^2=+0.5\ \mathrm{GeV}^2\); I’ll record that correction explicitly.
